## 1. Packages and data

```{r packages}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

library(pROC)

library(ggplot2)
set.seed(1213)
```

```{r data}
macro <- read_csv("../data/processed/fred_md_macro_clean_final.csv", show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  mutate(sasdate=as.Date(sasdate)) %>% arrange(sasdate) #Format Date
macro_fin <- read_csv("../data/processed/fred_md_macro_financial_clean_final.csv", show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  mutate(sasdate=as.Date(sasdate)) %>% arrange(sasdate) #Format Date

#Checking Month Continuity
month_index <- function(x) as.integer(format(x,"%Y"))*12L + as.integer(format(x,"%m"))
stopifnot(all(diff(month_index(macro$sasdate)) == 1L))
```

## 2. Target Construction: any recession within the next h months

`Y_h` is 1 if at least one of the months t+1 through t+h is recessionary.

```{r targets}
create_targets <- function(df) {
  df <- arrange(df, sasdate)
  for (h in c(3L,6L,12L)) {
    df[[paste0("Y_",h)]] <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
      if (i+h > nrow(df)) return(NA_integer_)
      future <- df$USREC[(i+1L):(i+h)]
      if (anyNA(future)) return(NA_integer_)
      as.integer(any(future == 1L))
    }, integer(1))
  }
  df
}
macro <- create_targets(macro)
macro_fin <- create_targets(macro_fin)
```

## 3. Forward-fill for missing values

```{r forward-fill}
predictor_cols <- setdiff(
  names(macro),
  c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12", "sample")
)
# forward fill function
forward_fill <- function(df) {
  predictor_cols <- setdiff(
    names(df),
    c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12", "sample")
  )
  df %>%
    arrange(sasdate) %>%
    fill(all_of(predictor_cols), .direction = "down")
}

macro_model <- forward_fill(macro)
macro_fin_model <- forward_fill(macro_fin)

# check if missing values still exist
sum(is.na(macro_model[predictor_cols]))
predictor_cols_fin <- setdiff(
  names(macro_fin_model),
  c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12", "sample")
)
sum(is.na(macro_fin_model[predictor_cols_fin]))
```

## 4. Gaussian Naive Bayes functions

```{r nb-functions}

fit_nb <- function(train, predictors, epsilon = 1e-6) {
  x <- train[, predictors, drop = FALSE]
  # Remove predictors with no variation
  valid <- predictors[vapply(x, function(z) {length(unique(z)) > 1L}, logical(1))]
  x <- x[, valid, drop = FALSE]
  # Prepare target
  x$target <- factor(train$target, levels = c(0, 1))
  # Fit Gaussian Naive Bayes
  fit <- e1071::naiveBayes(target ~ .,data = x,eps = epsilon,threshold = epsilon)
  list(fit = fit,predictors = valid)
}
predict_nb <- function(fitted, newdata) {
  x <- newdata[, fitted$predictors, drop = FALSE]
  as.numeric(predict(fitted$fit,newdata = x,type = "raw")[, "1"])
}

```

## 5. Monthly expanding-window forecasts

```{r forecast-function}

forecast_nb <- function(df, horizon, refit_every = 1L,
                        test_start = as.Date("1986-01-01")) {
  df <- arrange(df, sasdate)
  target <- paste0("Y_", horizon)
predictors <- setdiff(names(df),c("sasdate", "USREC", "Y_3", "Y_6", "Y_12", "sample"))  
# Identify out-of-sample observations
  test_indices <- which(df$sasdate >= test_start & !is.na(df[[target]]))
  output <- vector("list", length(test_indices))
  fitted <- NULL
  # Monthly expanding-window forecasting
  for (j in seq_along(test_indices)) {
    i <- test_indices[j]
    # Refit model at specified frequency
    if ((j - 1L) %% refit_every == 0L) {
      last_train <- i - horizon - 1L
      # Select eligible historical training observations
      train <- df[seq_len(last_train), , drop = FALSE] %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[target]])) %>%
        mutate(target = .data[[target]])
      # Fit Gaussian Naive Bayes
      fitted <- fit_nb(train, predictors)
    }
    # Generate out-of-sample recession probability
    output[[j]] <- data.frame(
      sasdate = df$sasdate[i],
      horizon = horizon,
      actual = df[[target]][i],
      predicted_prob = predict_nb(
        fitted,
        df[i, , drop = FALSE]
      )
    )
  }
  bind_rows(output)
}
run_nb_models <- function(datasets,horizons=c(3L,6L,12L)) {
  all_forecasts <- list()
  for (dataset_name in names(datasets)) {
    for (h in horizons) {
      res <- forecast_nb(datasets[[dataset_name]],horizon=h,refit_every=1L)
      res$dataset <- dataset_name
      res$model <- "Naive Bayes"
      all_forecasts[[paste(dataset_name,h,sep="_")]] <- res
    }
  }
  bind_rows(all_forecasts)
}
```

```{r forecasts}
#Running the models
datasets <- list(Macro=macro_model,Macro_Financial=macro_fin_model)
horizons <- c(3L,6L,12L)
nb_forecast_results <- run_nb_models(datasets,horizons)
```

```{r forecast-check}
#Out of sample forecast coverage (Ensures no duplicates etc)
nb_forecast_results %>% group_by(dataset,horizon) %>%
  summarise(n_forecasts=n(),unique_dates=n_distinct(sasdate),
            first_date=min(sasdate),last_date=max(sasdate),
            min_prob=min(predicted_prob),max_prob=max(predicted_prob),.groups="drop") %>%
  kable(digits=3,caption="Out-of-sample forecast coverage")
```

## 6. Evaluation

AUC uses a fixed ROC direction; F1 and balanced accuracy use a classification threshold of 0.50.

```{r evaluate}
calculate_auc <- function(y,p) {
  if (length(unique(y))<2L) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(y,p,levels=c(0,1),direction="<",quiet=TRUE)))
}

evaluate_forecasts <- function(df,threshold=0.5) {
  actual <- df$actual; prob <- df$predicted_prob
  predicted <- as.integer(prob>=threshold)
  TP <- sum(predicted==1 & actual==1); TN <- sum(predicted==0 & actual==0)
  FP <- sum(predicted==1 & actual==0); FN <- sum(predicted==0 & actual==1)
  precision <- if (TP+FP==0) 0 else TP/(TP+FP)
  recall <- if (TP+FN==0) NA_real_ else TP/(TP+FN)
  specificity <- if (TN+FP==0) NA_real_ else TN/(TN+FP)
  f1 <- if (is.na(recall)) NA_real_ else if (precision+recall==0) 0 else
    2*precision*recall/(precision+recall)
  data.frame(AUC=calculate_auc(actual,prob),F1=f1,
             Balanced_Accuracy=(recall+specificity)/2,
             Brier=mean((actual-prob)^2))
}
#Results
nb_evaluation_results <- nb_forecast_results %>%
  group_by(dataset,horizon,model) %>% group_modify(~evaluate_forecasts(.x)) %>% ungroup()
kable(nb_evaluation_results,digits=3,caption="Baseline Naive Bayes performance")
```

## 7. Incremental value of financial indicators

```{r financial-comparison}
compare_financial <- function(evaluations) {
  evaluations %>%
    select(dataset,horizon,model,AUC,F1,Balanced_Accuracy,Brier) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from=dataset,values_from=c(AUC,F1,Balanced_Accuracy,Brier)) %>%
    mutate(AUC_gain=AUC_Macro_Financial-AUC_Macro,
           F1_gain=F1_Macro_Financial-F1_Macro,
           Balanced_Accuracy_gain=Balanced_Accuracy_Macro_Financial-Balanced_Accuracy_Macro,
           Brier_improvement=Brier_Macro-Brier_Macro_Financial) %>%
    select(horizon,model,AUC_gain,F1_gain,Balanced_Accuracy_gain,Brier_improvement)
}
#Results
nb_financial_comparison <- compare_financial(nb_evaluation_results)
kable(nb_financial_comparison,digits=3,caption="Incremental financial-indicator value")
```

## 8. Paired moving-block bootstrap for AUC gain

```{r bootstrap-functions}
block_bootstrap_auc_gain <- function(actual,prob_macro,prob_fin,block_length=24L,n_boot=1000L) {
  #No. of Blocks
  n <- length(actual)
  if (n<block_length) stop("Block length exceeds sample size")
  n_blocks <- ceiling(n/block_length) #ensures enough obs
  #Re-sampling
  gains <- replicate(n_boot, {
    starts <- sample.int(n-block_length+1L,n_blocks,replace=TRUE)
    idx <- unlist(lapply(starts,function(s) seq.int(s,s+block_length-1L)))[seq_len(n)]
    #Calculate AUC improvement for each sample
    y <- actual[idx]
    if (length(unique(y))<2L) NA_real_ else
      calculate_auc(y,prob_fin[idx])-calculate_auc(y,prob_macro[idx])
  })
  if (!any(is.finite(gains))) stop("No valid bootstrap resamples")
  #confidence interval construction
  data.frame(AUC_gain=calculate_auc(actual,prob_fin)-calculate_auc(actual,prob_macro),
             CI_lower=unname(quantile(gains,.025,na.rm=TRUE)),
             CI_upper=unname(quantile(gains,.975,na.rm=TRUE)),
             valid_resamples=sum(is.finite(gains)))
}
paired_financial <- function(forecasts) {
  paired <- forecasts %>%
    select(sasdate,horizon,model,dataset,actual,predicted_prob) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from=dataset,values_from=c(actual,predicted_prob)) %>%
    arrange(horizon,model,sasdate)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(paired$actual_Macro),!anyNA(paired$actual_Macro_Financial),
            !anyNA(paired$predicted_prob_Macro),!anyNA(paired$predicted_prob_Macro_Financial),
            all(paired$actual_Macro==paired$actual_Macro_Financial))
  paired
}
#bootstrap per horizon
bootstrap_financial <- function(forecasts) {
  paired <- paired_financial(forecasts)
  paired %>% group_by(horizon,model) %>%
    group_modify(~block_bootstrap_auc_gain(.x$actual_Macro,
                                          .x$predicted_prob_Macro,
                                          .x$predicted_prob_Macro_Financial)) %>%
    ungroup() %>% mutate(significant=CI_lower>0 | CI_upper<0)
}
```

```{r auc-bootstrap}
set.seed(1213)
nb_auc_gain_ci <- bootstrap_financial(nb_forecast_results)
kable(nb_auc_gain_ci,digits=3,caption="Baseline AUC gains: paired 24-month block bootstrap")
```

## 9. Recession-by-recession evaluation

```{r recession-episodes}
#find recession start dates
test_start <- as.Date("1986-01-01")
test_recessions <- macro %>% arrange(sasdate) %>%
  filter(USREC==1,lag(USREC,default=0)==0,sasdate>=test_start) %>% pull(sasdate)
#no. of months between forecast and actually onset
month_diff <- function(a,b) {
  (as.integer(format(b,"%Y"))-as.integer(format(a,"%Y")))*12L +
    as.integer(format(b,"%m"))-as.integer(format(a,"%m"))
}
#matching episodes
recession_signals <- nb_forecast_results %>%
  tidyr::crossing(recession_start=test_recessions) %>%
  mutate(months_before=month_diff(sasdate,recession_start)) %>%
  filter(months_before>=1L,months_before<=horizon) %>%
  group_by(dataset,horizon,model,recession_start) %>%
  summarise(max_prob=max(predicted_prob),flagged=any(predicted_prob>=0.5),
            earliest_warning_months=if (any(predicted_prob>=0.5)) #no. of months before onset the first qualifying warning occurred
              max(months_before[predicted_prob>=0.5]) else NA_integer_,.groups="drop")
kable(recession_signals,digits=3,caption="Warnings before recession onsets")
#Results
recession_summary <- recession_signals %>% group_by(dataset,horizon,model) %>%
  summarise(recessions_flagged=sum(flagged),total_recessions=n(),.groups="drop") %>%
  left_join(nb_forecast_results %>% group_by(dataset,horizon,model) %>%
              summarise(false_alarm_months=sum(predicted_prob>=0.5 & actual==0),.groups="drop"),
            by=c("dataset","horizon","model"))
kable(recession_summary,caption="Recession detection and false-positive months")
```

## 10. ROC curves

```{r roc-curves, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
for (h in horizons) {
  d <- nb_forecast_results %>% filter(horizon==h)
  curves <- lapply(split(d,d$dataset),function(z)
    pROC::roc(z$actual,z$predicted_prob,levels=c(0,1),direction="<",quiet=TRUE))
  print(pROC::ggroc(curves,legacy.axes=TRUE) +
          geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=0,linetype="dashed",color="grey50") +
          labs(title=paste0("Naive Bayes ROC: ",h,"-month horizon"),
               x="False positive rate",y="True positive rate",color="Dataset") + theme_minimal())
}
```

## 11. Extension: selected lagged predictors

```{r lagged-data}
#Define lags
lag_spec <- list(UNRATE=c(3L,6L),PAYEMS=c(3L,6L),CPIAUCSL=c(3L,6L),
                 HOUST=c(3L,6L),S_P_500=c(3L,6L),T10YFFM=c(6L,12L))
add_selected_lags <- function(df,lag_spec) {
  df <- arrange(df,sasdate)
  for (variable in names(lag_spec)) {
    if (!variable %in% names(df)) next
    for (k in lag_spec[[variable]]) {
      df[[paste0(variable,"_lag",k)]] <- dplyr::lag(df[[variable]],k)
    }
  }
  df
}
#Add lags
macro_lagged <- add_selected_lags(macro_model,lag_spec)
macro_fin_lagged <- add_selected_lags(macro_fin_model,lag_spec)
lag_start <- macro_model$sasdate[13L] #remove the first 12m since longest lag is 12m to ensure lagged datasets starts on the same date
macro_lagged <- macro_lagged %>% filter(sasdate>=lag_start)
macro_fin_lagged <- macro_fin_lagged %>% filter(sasdate>=lag_start)
#verify identical
stopifnot(identical(macro_lagged$sasdate,macro_fin_lagged$sasdate))
```

```{r lagged-forecasts}
#Run models
datasets_lagged <- list(Macro=macro_lagged,Macro_Financial=macro_fin_lagged)
nb_forecast_results_lagged <- run_nb_models(datasets_lagged,horizons)
nb_evaluation_results_lagged <- nb_forecast_results_lagged %>%
  group_by(dataset,horizon,model) %>% group_modify(~evaluate_forecasts(.x)) %>% ungroup()
kable(nb_evaluation_results_lagged,digits=3,caption="Lagged Naive Bayes performance")
```

```{r lagged-financial-comparison}
#Comparison
nb_financial_comparison_lagged <- compare_financial(nb_evaluation_results_lagged)
kable(nb_financial_comparison_lagged,digits=3,caption="Financial-indicator gains with lagged predictors")
```

```{r lagged-financial-bootstrap}
#bootstrap to compare between macro only and macro + fin
set.seed(1213)
nb_auc_gain_ci_lagged <- bootstrap_financial(nb_forecast_results_lagged)
kable(nb_auc_gain_ci_lagged,digits=3,caption="Lagged-model financial AUC gains: paired block bootstrap")
```

## 12. Baseline versus lagged predictors

```{r lag-comparison}
#match predictions
paired_lag <- nb_forecast_results %>%
  select(sasdate,horizon,model,dataset,actual,prob_original=predicted_prob) %>%
  inner_join(nb_forecast_results_lagged %>%
               select(sasdate,horizon,model,dataset,actual,prob_lagged=predicted_prob),
             by=c("sasdate","horizon","model","dataset","actual")) %>%
  arrange(dataset,horizon,sasdate)
stopifnot(nrow(paired_lag)==nrow(nb_forecast_results), #verify matched
          nrow(paired_lag)==nrow(nb_forecast_results_lagged))
nb_lag_performance <- paired_lag %>% group_by(dataset,horizon,model) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    original <- evaluate_forecasts(data.frame(actual=.x$actual,predicted_prob=.x$prob_original))
    lagged <- evaluate_forecasts(data.frame(actual=.x$actual,predicted_prob=.x$prob_lagged))
    data.frame(n_paired=nrow(.x),AUC_original=original$AUC,AUC_lagged=lagged$AUC,
               AUC_change=lagged$AUC-original$AUC,
               Brier_original=original$Brier,Brier_lagged=lagged$Brier,
               Brier_improvement=original$Brier-lagged$Brier)
  }) %>% ungroup()
kable(nb_lag_performance,digits=3,caption="Baseline versus lagged predictors on matched test months")
```

```{r lag-bootstrap}
#bootstrap to compare baseline vs lagged
set.seed(1213)
nb_lag_gain_ci <- paired_lag %>% group_by(dataset,horizon,model) %>%
  group_modify(~block_bootstrap_auc_gain(.x$actual,.x$prob_original,.x$prob_lagged)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% rename(AUC_change=AUC_gain) %>%
  mutate(significant=CI_lower>0 | CI_upper<0)
kable(nb_lag_gain_ci,digits=3,caption="Lagged versus baseline AUC: paired block bootstrap")
```
